style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted:
Add festive charm to your home with the 2m Prelit Slim Newberry Spruce. Its slender profile is ideal for tighter spaces, while still offering the rich, natural look of a classic spruce tree. Prelit with warm white LEDs, it creates a cozy and inviting atmosphere without the fuss of stringing lights.

• Height: 2 meters tall — great for apartments, smaller rooms, or stylish setups.
• Slim Profile: Spacesaving design that doesn’t compromise on festive appeal.
• Prelit: Warm white LED lights evenly distributed for a gentle, radiant glow.
• Realistic Foliage: Lifelike spruce needles with natural color and texture.
• Built with quality materials to last through many holiday seasons.
• Easy Assembly: Simple setup for hasslefree decorating.
